About the Scholarship

ANU University Research Scholarships provide competitive support for higher degree research. This entry is for the domestic application round for 2027: international applicants should not use the domestic deadline, because their advertised round has already closed. Australian National University invites applications for a PhD position in this area: ANU University Research Scholarships: Domestic Round 2027. The work sits within All Subjects. The role is based in Canberra, Australia. According to the listing, full funding is provided; financial support is listed as AUD 40,475/year (2027 rate). Interested candidates should note the deadline: 31 October 2026 (domestic round).

Research Areas

  • Eligible ANU research subjects
  • Doctoral research
  • Research training

About Australian National University

ANU offers higher degrees by research across its academic colleges. Research scholarship applicants are assessed through university funding rounds, with different application dates for domestic and international candidates.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://study.anu.edu.au/scholarships/find-scholarship/anu-university-research-scholarships

Source: study.anu.edu.au - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 31 October 2026 (domestic round) - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Review the eligibility criteria carefully; applications outside the stated scope are usually rejected at the first screening stage.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 31 October 2026 (domestic round). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example

English language requirements

This ANU round is for domestic applicants - Australian and New Zealand citizens and Australian permanent residents - who are not asked for an English test. International applicants are considered in ANU's international scholarship rounds, where English proficiency is assessed through IELTS, TOEFL or accepted equivalents.
